title: Volcanoes of Nicaragua
intro: 10 volcanoes of Nicaragua, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Mombacho
rounds.fact: Mombacho is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1570. The data places it in Nicaragua.
